summary: Turn an object into key-and-value records you can work with.
documentation: Object.entries returns an array containing the own enumerable string-keyed properties of an object as [key, value] pairs. Inherited and symbol-keyed properties are not included.
inputs: An object whose own string-keyed properties should be listed.
caution: Property enumeration has defined ordering rules, but a report should explicitly sort when a particular presentation order matters.
scenarios: Turn inventory quantities into rows for a report.
Display a settings dictionary as labeled values.
Convert a count-by-category object into chart inputs.
title: List stock quantities by code
problem: Input is an object whose lowercase alphabetic keys are stock codes and whose values are integer quantities. Return its [key, value] pairs sorted by key ascending.
goal: Use Object.entries() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
hint: Use Object.entries, then sort the pairs by their first element.
